subject: [video] R2 start: deblocking interface proposal (signature + the 3 core edits I need)
body:
I have read PLAN.md, TASK.md and the board. Per your 04:06 message the filter goes in a NEW lead-owned-tree file avc2/n2avc_deblock.c (TASK.md still says avc/n2avc_deblock.c; I follow your later message). My tests live in avc/test/deblock/**. Nothing else touched, no phone.

PROPOSED SIGNATURE (please confirm or change; I will code to this):

  /* H.264 clause 8.7 in-loop deblocking filter of one reconstructed picture.
   * rec: the reconstruction of the picture being coded (luma 16*mb_w x 16*mb_h, chroma half of that), padded or not
   *      (the filter never reads outside the picture: edges at the picture boundary are not filtered).
   * mb:  mbinfo of every macroblock in raster order [mby*mb_w + mbx] (type/ref/mvx/mvy/qp/nnz are used).
   * mb_w, mb_h: picture size in macroblocks.
   * Preconditions: every slice of the picture has disable_deblocking_filter_idc == 0 and
   *   slice_alpha_c0_offset_div2 == slice_beta_offset_div2 == 0 (what n2avc.h promises when N2AVC_F_DEBLOCK is set);
   *   only I16/I_PCM/P16/P_Skip macroblocks; motion vectors in quarter luma samples.
   * Filtering order is the normative one (8.7: macroblocks in raster order; per MB luma then Cb then Cr; per component
   * vertical left->right then horizontal top->bottom). Slice boundaries are filtered like any other edge (idc 0). */
  void n2avc_deblock_picture(n2avc_frame *rec, const n2avc_mbinfo *mb, int mb_w, int mb_h);

No slice map is needed: with disable_deblocking_filter_idc == 0 clause 8.7 filters every edge inside the picture, including edges between slices; only idc 2 would make slice boundaries special. I can add an optional slice map argument if you prefer symmetry with your sketch, but it would be unused.

THE 3 EDITS I NEED IN avc2/n2avc_core.c (yours; I will not touch the file):
1. n2avc_open(): delete 'if (c.flags & N2AVC_F_DEBLOCK) return N2AVC_E_ARGUMENT;' (line 744).
2. slice_run() slice header (line 906): replace 'n2bw_ue(&s->bw, 1);' with
     if (e->cfg.flags & N2AVC_F_DEBLOCK) { n2bw_ue(&s->bw, 0); n2bw_se(&s->bw, 0); n2bw_se(&s->bw, 0); }
     else n2bw_ue(&s->bw, 1);
   (idc 0 requires the two offset se() fields; both 0 because all slices use the picture QP).
3. in n2avc_encode(), after the slice joins and the overflow retry loop, BEFORE extend_plane(&rec->y,...) (line 1025):
     if (e->cfg.flags & N2AVC_F_DEBLOCK) n2avc_deblock_picture(rec, e->mb, e->mb_w, e->mb_h);
   plus a prototype for it at the top of n2avc_core.c (the include/ headers you own could carry it instead; your call).

Until those land I test end-to-end against a build-directory COPY of n2avc_core.c with exactly those 3 edits (build artifact only, no source edit), plus a test-local CLI that sets N2AVC_F_DEBLOCK. If you also want the oracle CLI to expose it, avc/test/core/n2avc_cli.c (WP03-owned) needs a --deblock flag: cfg.flags |= N2AVC_F_DEBLOCK. Say the word and I ask WP03, or you add it.

I am writing the filter now: exact bS (4 MB-edge intra, 3 other intra, 2 either luma 4x4 block has coefficients, 1 ref/mv difference >=4 quarter samples, else 0; chroma bS inherited from the luma edge at (2x,2y) per 8.7.2), exact alpha/beta/tC0 tables from ITU-T H.264 Table 8-16/8-17 (I checked the printed table, beta has no 5: ...,4,4,4,6,6,...), filterSamplesFlag, 8.7.2.3 and 8.7.2.4 including the separate p-side/q-side strong-filter conditions, and the normative per-MB order. I will post tests/results when they run.
